adjudicated_statement: Work over C with Q-coefficients at (g,n)=(6,6). Let C_aff be the smooth connected affine curve obtained from the smooth projective model Cbar of y^3=x(x-1) by deleting the three ramification points of the degree-three x-map. Riemann-Hurwitz in characteristic zero gives genus one: 2g-2=3(-2)+3(3-1)=0. Compact-support localization yields H_c^2(C_aff;Q)=Q(-1) of type (1,1) and Gr^W_1 H_c^1(C_aff;Q) isomorphic to H^1(Cbar;Q) of types (1,0) and (0,1). Let S=C_aff^8, a smooth connected affine C-scheme of dimension 8, in particular reduced, locally Noetherian, separated, and of finite type. Compact-support Kunneth of mixed Hodge structures places a nonzero Hodge type-(8,4) class in Gr^W_12 H_c^{12}(S;Q), namely the summand Q(-1)^{tensor 4} tensor (Gr^W_1 H_c^1(C_aff;Q))^{tensor 4}. Let (C_0,gamma_0) be a simply-branched balanced type-(i) geometric fibre of H^bal (existence by FND-0172; equivalently Bujokas-Patel: the Casnati-Ekedahl bundle of a general cover in H_{d,g} is balanced for g>=(d-3)(d-1), hence at (d,g)=(4,6)). The constant (CE)+(N)+(BAL) family over S with this fibre is an allowed ATT-0112 clause-(E) base, because its classifying image is a single type-(i) point and is not contained in the type-(ii) locus. For this family, U isomorphic to S times U_0 and Z=Ord(U) isomorphic to S times Z_0, where U_0 is the reduced-support open in |L_0| isomorphic to P^2, a nonempty smooth connected affine surface, so H_c^4(U_0;Q)=Q(-2) of type (2,2) by Poincare duality (equivalently, compact-support localization of U_0 subset P^2 against the discriminant curve of dimension 1). Compact-support Kunneth therefore realises Gr^W_12 H_c^{12}(S;Q)(-2) as a direct mixed-Hodge-structure summand of Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(U;Q), carrying a nonzero Hodge type-(10,6) class, permitted by Deligne's Hodge-number bound on the 10-fold U. Finite-etale transfer over Q injects this S_6-invariant class into Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(Z;Q). A finite direct sum of Q(-8) is pure of type (8,8), so Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(Z;Q) is not a finite direct sum of Q(-8), and T_16(Z):=W_{-16} H^{BM}_{16}(Z;Q), canonically dual with no extra Tate twist, is not a finite direct sum of Q(8). Consequently the exact TASK-C66-M-004/C66-TATE-SUPPORT theorem of campaign revision 4, as universally quantified over every reduced locally Noetherian C-scheme carrying a (CE)+(N)+(BAL) genus-six degree-four family with no connected-component image contained in the type-(ii) locus and with no dimension, dominance, or non-isotriviality hypothesis, is false. The witness lies entirely in the simply-branched locus and already in the S_6-invariant isotypic component. The class is a Kunneth summand of H_c^{16}(U) itself, namely the third FND-0167 corner Gr^W_12 H_c^{12}(S)(-2), not a lift of Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(S), so FND-0171 does not block it. This does not resolve RED-0001, does not identify T_16(Z) with the global kernel K, does not address T_16 of a dimension-17 model over a named 15-dimensional etale atlas of Hbar^bal, does not refute the conditional implication of FND-0167 (the witness violates (H-S) at j=6 and at j=7), and does not disprove the campaign-revision-5 C66-TATE-SUPPORT theorem, which asks for Tate type of the FND-0180 kernel-form subquotient T_Z of W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) rather than of T_16(Z) for every clause-(E) base.
contradiction_resolution: Mandatory first reads of ATT-0119 and REV-0168 confirm the contested passage: CLM-0119-1 through CLM-0119-6 construct, on the constant simply-branched balanced type-(i) family over S=C^8, a Kunneth summand Gr^W_12 H_c^{12}(S) tensor H_c^4(U_0)=Gr^W_12 H_c^{12}(S)(-2) of Hodge type (10,6) in Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(U;Q), injected by rational S_6-transfer into Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(Z;Q). REV-0168 independently confirmed every claim, explicitly distinguished the class from the blocked j=8 atlas corner of FND-0171, and recorded the same candidate statement now labelled FND-0179. Independent primary-source checks support the load-bearing Hodge and existence inputs: Stacks Project tag 0C1B gives 2g_X-2=(2g_Y-2)deg(f)+sum(e_x-1) in characteristic zero, so the cyclic cover y^3=x(x-1) of P^1, totally ramified of index 3 at 0,1,infinity, has genus one; Deligne, Theorie de Hodge III (Publ. Math. IHES 44 (1974), doi 10.1007/BF02685881), together with the encyclopedia account of mixed Hodge structures, supplies functorial mixed Hodge structures on (compactly supported) cohomology of complex algebraic varieties, an abelian category with strict morphisms, Tate twists Q(-n) of type (n,n), and Kunneth compatibility, so four H_c^2=Q(-1) factors and four Gr^W_1 H_c^1 factors on C_aff^8 produce a nonzero type-(8,4) class in Gr^W_12 H_c^{12}, and Poincare duality on a connected smooth surface yields H_c^4(U_0)=Q(-2) of type (2,2), hence type (10,6) after tensoring; Bujokas-Patel arXiv:1504.03756v1 Main Theorem supplies balanced F for a general cover in H_{d,g} once g>=(d-3)(d-1), hence at (4,6), so a simply-branched balanced type-(i) fibre exists. No contradiction with claims.jsonl: RED-0001 and THM-0001--THM-0007 concern W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{g,n}) or compactified tautological ranges, not T_16 of a clause-(E) product model; FND-0179's own contradicts_claim_ids is empty. Compatible with corroborated packet fences: FND-0168 (do not identify T_16(Z) with K), FND-0164 (no constructible-coefficient compact-support Leray is used), FND-0171 (the class is already the third FND-0167/Kunneth summand of H_c^{16}(U), not a reverse transport of the j=8 first summand), and FND-0169/FND-0170 (atlas-corner non-Tateness is a different object). The candidate is mathematically correct on the revision-4 universally quantified lemma, but it is not novel: packet C66-001-v5 already records the same witness, the same type-(10,6) class, and the same theorem-falsity as corroborated FND-0178, with the general product-family mechanism recorded as corroborated FND-0176. Campaign revision 5 has already repaired C66-TATE-SUPPORT to Tate type of the FND-0180 kernel-form T_Z inside W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q); FND-0179 does not disprove that repaired theorem. Original wording is too loose ('not a direct sum' rather than 'not a finite direct sum'; 'affine elliptic Kummer curve' without the Riemann-Hurwitz and localization hypotheses; no explicit (CE)+(N)+(BAL), Q-coefficients, or duality convention). Therefore FND-0179 should be merged into FND-0178 rather than promoted, retained as a parallel candidate, or retired as false.
